tasks.title: Setup Basic Project Structure
tasks.description: Initialize both Java Plugin and Node.js Mineflayer projects with proper directory structure, dependencies, and build configurations.
tasks.details:
For Java Plugin:
1. Create a Maven/Gradle project with Java 17+
2. Add Spigot/Paper 1.20.4+ API dependency
3. Setup plugin.yml with proper metadata
4. Add dependencies: Gson 2.10.1+, Java-WebSocket 1.5.3+
5. Create basic package structure (com.minecraft.aicompanion)

For Mineflayer Bot:
1. Initialize Node.js project (npm init) with Node.js 18+
2. Install dependencies: mineflayer 4.8.1+, ws 8.13.0+ (WebSocket), mineflayer-pathfinder 2.4.2+
3. Create basic directory structure (src/, config/, etc.)
4. Setup TypeScript (optional but recommended) with tsconfig.json
5. Create basic .env file template for configuration

Create shared configuration files for development environment setup and documentation.
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Verify project builds successfully without errors
2. Confirm all dependencies resolve correctly
3. Test basic plugin loading in a test Minecraft server
4. Verify Mineflayer bot can connect to a test server
5. Document setup process for development team

tasks.title: Implement WebSocket Communication System
tasks.description: Develop a bidirectional WebSocket communication system between the Java Plugin and Mineflayer Bot with a standardized message protocol.
tasks.details:
1. Create WebSocket server in Java Plugin using Java-WebSocket library:
   - Implement WebSocketServer class with onOpen, onClose, onMessage, and onError handlers
   - Add connection management for multiple bots
   - Implement heartbeat mechanism for connection monitoring

2. Create WebSocket client in Mineflayer Bot using ws library:
   - Implement connection with automatic reconnection logic
   - Add event handlers for messages, connection, and errors

3. Design and implement JSON message protocol as specified in PRD:
   ```json
   {
     "type": "command|response|event",
     "id": "unique_message_id",
     "timestamp": "ISO_8601_timestamp",
     "data": {
       "action": "move|attack|build|speak|...",
       "parameters": {...},
       "result": {...}
     }
   }
   ```

4. Implement message serialization/deserialization using Gson (Java) and JSON.parse/stringify (Node.js)
5. Add message queue system to handle communication delays
6. Implement error handling and logging for communication issues
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Unit tests for message serialization/deserialization
2. Integration tests for WebSocket connection establishment
3. Test reconnection logic by forcibly disconnecting
4. Stress test with high message volume
5. Test error handling with malformed messages
6. Measure and optimize latency between components

subtasks.title: Design and Implement JSON Message Protocol

subtasks.title: Implement Message Serialization and Queue System
subtasks.description: Create serialization/deserialization logic and a message queue system to handle communication delays.
subtasks.details: Implement message serialization/deserialization using Gson in Java and JSON.parse/stringify in Node.js. Create a message queue system with priority handling. Implement retry logic for failed message delivery. Add mechanisms to handle out-of-order messages. Create a system to track message delivery status.
